text:
maria: Heads up: I'm putting forward a small telemetry change proposalto surface an "effective_identity" enum on every request event so Console and billing/routing teams can disambiguate tokens (org-key vs project-key vs sa-exchange). We keep it opaque (no raw ids).
devon: Good idea. Right now `request.origin` is too noisy for exchanged flows.
kevin: Agree in principle. We should decide whether this is read-only telemetry or if we let routing consult it. Mixing observation and control could lead to surprising behavior.
maria: Proposal: telemetry-only initially. Add Console column (hidden behind FF) that shows effective_identity and a short hover tooltip. After 10 days of collection, run an experiment to see if routing adjustments are safe.
sam: Implementation detail: who annotates the event? The edge proxy or the exchange service? Also, how do we handle tokens that were revoked or external impersonations?
jess: Annotator logic idea: inspect token claims and the exchange trace (if present). Rules: if token.claims contain `sa_id` and `exchange.path` exists => "sa-exchange". If token.issued_for_project == project_id => "project-key". If token.scope == org_admin => "org-key". Also emit `is_exchanged: true/false`.
kevin: Please don't log any raw token or plaintext IDs. Store only an enum and a reversible hashed correlation key (for internal debug) e.g., `identity_hash:h:abcd`.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-annotator-v1 rollout started (canary: 7% traffic)
maria: Example emitted object I envision:
```
req_id=r-1a2b3c4d | effective_identity=sa-exchange | origin_hint=exchange-proxy | quota_bucket=project:acme-prod | identity_hash=h:9a1b
```
kevin: Nice. Also emit a counter metric `identity.routing.delta` tagged with identity and actual_route (hosted/dedicated) so we can quantify how often identity diverges from billing route.
devon: Downstream consumers: billing, Console analytics, SRE routing monitors. Console should not show the column unless the org has >= 1k requests with identity data to avoid misleading single-sample signals.
sam: UX/privacy Q: do we show this to customers in their logs? Might reveal internal routing heuristics.
jess: We should show it only as a lightweight label and include a docs link: "Derived label may represent exchanged or proxied identities and is for operational insight." Also provide an opt-out or restrict to org admins.
maria: Rollout plan: 1) proxy service annotator + async identity_resolved events; 2) backfill last 7 days for active orgs via batch job; 3) Console feature flag + tooltip; 4) 10-day telemetry analysis -> route-experiment decision.
kevin: For perf: do minimal sync tagging at request time (enum only), then do async heavy enrichment. Add rate-limiting if identity resolution requires extra RPCs.
jess: We'll implement `identity_resolver` that writes a small follow-up event linking by req_id. The event stream will have `identity_unresolved` then `identity_resolved`.
developer-note: Update RBAC + token-rotation playbook + canary checklist. Also add metrics: `identity.enrich.latency` and `identity.resolution.failures`.
maria: Action items: @jess - PR for proxy annotator + schema. @kevin - dashboard draft for `identity.routing.delta` and enrich latency. @devon - Console FF + tooltip copy. @sam - draft privacy blurb for Legal.
sam: I'll draft it, suggest language: "No raw tokens or user identifiers are exposed. Effective identity is a derived label for routing and observability"
kevin: One more: if we later use effective_identity to affect routing, quota attribution MUST remain tied to original billing project. Routing priority can differ but billing/quotas cannot shift. Add that constraint in design doc.
maria: Agreed. Let's target landing the telemetry PR by EOD Thursday so we can run a weekend canary. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
